JB 01 — WHAT WE HAUL

Services built around the load, not the other way around

Interstate Linehaul

Scheduled runs along the east-coast corridor — Melbourne to Sydney, Brisbane, and Adelaide — with fixed transit windows.

General Freight

Palletised and loose freight for retail, trade, and manufacturing clients, priced by weight, volume, or dock-to-dock rate.

Bulk & Palletised Loads

Full and part-truckload capacity for bulk materials and construction supply, with flatbed and curtainsider options.

Warehousing & Cross-Dock

Short-term storage and cross-dock handling at our Melbourne yard, keeping freight moving without gaps in the chain.

Time-Critical Freight

Priority dispatch for urgent jobs, with direct driver contact and live ETA updates from pickup to drop-off.

Contract & Account Freight

Ongoing rate agreements for businesses with regular volume, with a single point of contact and consolidated invoicing.

JB 05 — ABOUT US

Established 2018. A fleet run properly.

JB Road Transport is a Melbourne-based operator, established in 2018, running a fleet across general and interstate freight. We'd rather grow steadily and keep every truck maintained and every delivery on time than chase volume we can't service properly.

  • —

    Board Member, National Road Freighters Association

    Our director sits on the NRFA board, taking part in monthly industry meetings on safety, efficiency, and standards across Australian trucking.

  • —

    Engaged at the federal level

    We've taken part in industry roundtables at Parliament House, Canberra, alongside transport unions, associations, and major carriers.

  • —

    ATA Multicultural Driver Roundtable

    Invited by the Australian Trucking Association to contribute to discussions on industry inclusion, safety, and workforce development.

INDUSTRY ROUNDTABLE — PARLIAMENT HOUSE, CANBERRA
JB 06 — JOIN THE FLEET

We're hiring drivers

JB Road Transport is currently taking on drivers for local and interstate runs. We're a fleet where you're not just a number on a roster.

What we're after

Current HR or HC licence, clean driving record, and a solid work ethic. Interstate experience is a plus but not essential for local roles.

What you get

Well-maintained trucks, straight communication from dispatch, and consistent runs rather than last-minute scrambling.

How to apply

Send your licence details and a bit about your experience to jbroadmanagement@gmail.com and we'll get back to you.
